### Note

The project had no `go.mod`, so `go build ./...` initially failed with *"directory prefix . does not contain main module"*. I ran `go mod init scratch-app` to initialize the module (standard-library-only, `go mod tidy` reports nothing to add). This was a minimal prerequisite fix, not a scope change.

### Final `main.go`

```go
package main

import "fmt"

// add returns the sum of a and b.
func add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

// subtract returns the difference of a and b.
func subtract(a, b int) int { return a - b }

func main() {
	fmt.Println(add(2, 3))
	fmt.Println(subtract(5, 3))
}
```
